title: Kingston–Brockville illustrative hydraulic estimates: local-stage wet-mask correction
selected_method: Simplified, unvalidated steady nonlinear Manning diffusion-wave approximation

model_period.type: Steady mean-condition scenario, NOT an hourly current-field average

correction.problem: A global minimum Brockville-stage wetting test wrongly removed shallow water at upstream local stages, including Bayfield southern mouth.
correction.method: Start a maximum possible upstream-stage wet candidate; repeatedly solve, prune at local actual depth < 0.12 m and activate through orthogonal wet-neighbour faces above 0.13 m; preserve stage-anchored components; require a fixed mask and zero floor cells.
correction.shallow_southern_mouth_caveat: The 0.342 m maximum-clearance-path bottleneck uses inferred bed. Raising only physical southern-mouth bed by 0.25 m at fixed solved stage closes that path; this is a topology diagnostic, not a recomputed flow scenario.

held_out_stage.observation_quality: preliminary, one missing six-minute value interpolated only for time-weighted stage mean

earlier_configuration_diagnostics.scope: Retained checks from earlier inlet/wet-mask configurations. Not newly run validation of this local-stage correction.

prior_domain_sensitivity.scope: Retained checks on the original inlet location; these are NOT newly run validation of the padded domain.

roughness_m20percent.calculation: Exact inverse-n scaling at constant imposed stages, global uniform resistance only.

roughness_p20percent.calculation: Exact inverse-n scaling at constant imposed stages, global uniform resistance only.

grid_sensitivity.scope: Both runs independently calibrated to the same total regulation-Q scenario. Nearest coarse cell to each fine centroid; statistics exclude noncommon wet cells. This is a grid sensitivity check, not formal asymptotic convergence or validation.

momentum_comparison.method: experimental semi-implicit full-momentum depth-averaged shallow-water estimate
momentum_comparison.reason_rejected: The full-momentum experimental solver strongly disagreed with the regulated discharge at the selected resistance and retained residual boundary seiche. Advection/grid losses are unresolved; it is not an accuracy upgrade.

inertia_and_energy_diagnostics.interpretation: Conservation is a numerical property, not field validation. DWE omits inertia and cannot enforce full kinetic-energy/momentum balances; local fast jets and island wakes are uncertain. Acceleration ratios and kinetic head are diagnostics only, not clipping/correction rules. Inlet kinetic energy and unresolved subcell velocities are not measured.

major_limitations: No momentum inertia, inertial wakes, wind, Coriolis, thermal density stratification or surface shear.
A global discharge fit plus one held-out stage does not validate local current vectors or channel flow splits.
The DWE permits a small number of energetically suspect fast jets; their speeds are not quantitatively trustworthy. Do not use this for navigation.
NONNA source survey datums are heterogeneous; the interpolated Kingston/Brockville chart-datum separation is estimated, not authoritative.
About 17.68% of the selected wet-cell bed is inferred near banks; some channel sections have substantial flux adjacent to inferred bed.
Two-grid sensitivity checks do not establish strict asymptotic convergence.

widest_baseline_path.note: One highest-clearance face-connected path, not a measured transport corridor or count of all cells carrying discharge.
One highest-clearance face-connected path, not a measured transport corridor or count of all cells carrying discharge.

independent_current_review.path_sensitivity_note: Topology-only diagnostic with fixed solved levels and selected wet footprint. Bed changes apply only inside the named mouth rectangle, leaving bay interior and main channel unchanged. Positive shift raises bed; negative shift cannot delete a previously wet connection. No revised currents are inferred. Separate path windows isolate each mouth, and threshold remains0.12m.

portable_reproduction.note: Imports, boundary CSV, source arrays and bed preparation are package-local. Numerical tolerances, not byte-identical output containers, define reproduction.

encoding_correction_check.scope: Only UTF-8 label correction and LF normalization after the full isolated numerical rebuild; re-export exactly reproduces the frozen original field. Numerical solver content and all numerical data are unchanged.
